review_text: The place is clean and easy to find. The design is modern and have good ambiance. My son loves the pizza and said that the chocolate drink is really good. I love their tea sets and the tea itself.

Unavoidably along the road right beside Twin Palms Residences, your eyes will revert to the two floors of space and sufficient parking lot. Staff were friendlier than their other branch. Menu had a lot to suggest….And because it’s Kadayawan month, I went to pick up the (limited) specials— the CEREAL DURIAN LATTE and the TARO COCONUT LATTE. So, come in for ‘em before they’re gone!

Though we understand that they do not allow outside food and we respect that. We were just sad that we were not able to eat the cake we brought to have a low-key celebration for a friend's birthday even though we ordered from their menu. I hope they will consider it soon.
